title: A balance of decisions
use: Trade-offs, dependencies, competing priorities and reflective editorial titles.
description: A two-tier brass mobile transfers a slow rocking motion through articulated beams and hanging ceramic counterweights.
copy: Use the connected motion to introduce a trade-off, then cut to native evidence. A single short line can sit beside the hanging forms.
metaphor: A choreographed sculpture, not a physics simulation or a chart of actual weights or values.
